comment: The block moves and string instructions on a program written for the test (tests/programs/library.program.json): an overlapping MOVE_BLK, a COUNT that does not fit (nothing moved, ENO FALSE), FILL_BLK, MOVE_BLK_VARIANT, REPLACE past the end, DELETE of more than there is, STRG_VAL with an exponent and a decimal comma, VAL_STRG with a comma and a sign, a number too long for SIZE, PREC on an integer, Strg_TO_Chars and Chars_TO_Strg, FIND of an empty string.
